patch.value: Resolve live fragment text through the public SDK

pm-web PR 278 cannot render live fragments independently of historical retention through the published SDK. Expose a pure text-only entry to the existing exact resolver using the same strict text and descriptor schema as citation producers; no source I/O, state writes or duplicate JSON normalization.

Root SDK export resolves unchanged and changed file, heading and raw JSON spans independently of retained originals; large integer, exponent, escaped string and own prototype-key spellings remain exact; invalid inputs return typed safe remedies; 500 seeded sequences re-read native SDK state unchanged; npm and Bun packed consumers import the public export.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Adds resolveFragmentText(text, descriptor) as a pure public entry to the existing production resolveFragment implementation, with one strict request schema composed from producer text/descriptor schemas. No selector, JSON parser, source reader or native writer is duplicated. Focused source/SDK tests passed 9/9, including 500 seeded sequences, 2036 random source operations, six producer descriptors, older replays, whitespace/CRLF, exact raw JSON spellings, and native SDK read-back after every sequence in a Gitless tracker. Linked consumer work is pm-web-5sx6 / pm-web-cnhi and PR https://github.com/unbraind/pm-web/pull/278.
